headline: Crude Oil Benchmark Prices Fall Across Dated Brent, Urals, and Azeri Light
summary: Average crude prices for Azeri Light, Dated Brent, and Urals declined over the week of November 16-20 according to market data.
why: Crude oil benchmarks set pricing standards for international petroleum shipments and energy derivatives contracts globally.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Weekly average prices for global crude oil benchmarks receded.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weekly average prices across major global crude oil streams moved lower.
